ordered_branches.explanation: Reads configured IDs/file names/max sizes for long-running, blocked and deadlock traces. Condition0 stops active positive IDs, closes them and sets configured IDs0. Condition1 creates IDs<1, configures the explicit event/column matrix (long IDs10,43,45,12,41; blocked137; deadlock148), applies active TRACE_FILTER rows to long trace, starts streams and stores IDs. Creation return code is assigned but not checked. @filterValue declared nvarchar without length is one character, truncating string filter values; default bigint2000000 is overwritten by cursor values and no filter is applied if cursor empty. @LongTraceID initialized twice while deadlock ID remainsNULL until lookup, so missing config can skip creation then passNULL to calls. Default condition2 skips control but still reads status/path; output path truncated to80 characters. PMN_Trace first tests @@version against a fixed pattern. Matching branch calls PMN_EVENT_SESSION with condition plus startDateTime, while captured child signature accepts only condition: static argument-count mismatch. Other branch uses captured underscore column names and appends the caller startDateTime string directly to filenames; startDateTime has no default.

NO_CAPTURED_REFERENCE means none of the credited channels in this exact retained corpus identified the table. It does not establish that the table is unused, obsolete, a backup, safe to delete, or absent from external application SQL.
